description: Use when assessing whether a software category faces near-term displacement risk, or timing a market entry or exit decision. Returns disruption risk score from 0 to 1 with evidence strings from citation volume patterns. Example: ERP category — disruption risk score 0.71, evidence: 34 citations referencing AI-native alternatives, 12 referencing no-code replacements — HIGH disruption risk for legacy on-premise vendors. Source: Stratalize citation volume heuristics. $0.10 USDC per call.
name: get_category_disruption_signal
title: Get Category Disruption Signal
